description: This file defines extension methods for scheduling and queueing tasks related to Orleans grain contexts, providing utility functions to manage asynchronous work items within the Orleans runtime scheduler.

classes.name: SchedulerExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for scheduling tasks within the Orleans grain execution context.

methods.name: QueueTask
methods.description: Queues a task for execution within the specified grain context's scheduler.

methods.name: QueueTask
methods.description: Queues a task within a work item group for the specified target context.

methods.name: QueueAction
methods.description: Queues an action with a specific state within the target context, optionally with a name.

methods.name: RunOrQueueTask
methods.description: Runs the provided task if the current context matches the target context; otherwise, queues it for execution.
